author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
**UserSlash** loaded!

**Setup (one-time):**
1. Go to the **Discord Developer Portal** → Your Application → **Installation**
2. Under *Installation Contexts*, enable **User Install**
3. Under *Default Install Settings — User Install*, add the `applications.commands` scope
4. Run `[p]userslash sync` to register & patch commands
5. Share the OAuth2 User-Install link so users can add your bot to their profile!

⚠️ **Unload OneTrueSlash** first if you have it loaded — this cog replaces it.

All Red text commands are now accessible as slash commands in servers, DMs, and group DMs.
name: UserSlash
short: User-installable slash commands — every Red command works in servers, DMs, and group DMs.
description: UserSlash replaces OneTrueSlash with full user-install support. It registers a single proxy slash command (named after the bot) that bridges all Red text commands, then patches every global command with user-install integration types. Commands work everywhere: guild channels, bot DMs, group DMs, and even servers where the bot isn't a member. Includes owner commands for syncing, patching, and checking status. Gracefully handles non-guild contexts with helpful error messages when a command requires a server.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
